references.summary: Annual cereal harvested for dry grain. Cold tolerance changes with acclimation; reproductive tissues become more frost-sensitive as the ear develops. Heat and water stress during flowering and grain filling can reduce grain set and grain weight. Broadleaf break crops can interrupt some cereal disease cycles; grass weeds and volunteer cereals can maintain hosts. Cultivar, sowing date, vernalisation and photoperiod affect time to stem elongation and flowering.
